description: This file defines a TimeoutManager class used for managing timeouts in test execution, including handling of different test phases, fixtures, and error reporting.

classes.name: TimeoutManager
classes.description: Manages test timeouts, including starting, updating, and handling timeout errors for test runnables.

classes.name: TimeoutManagerError
classes.description: Custom error class for timeout-related errors.

methods.name: setIgnoreTimeouts
methods.description: Sets the manager to ignore all timeouts.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Rejects the current timeout promise, effectively interrupting the current runnable.

methods.name: isTimeExhaustedFor
methods.description: Checks if the allotted time for a runnable has been exhausted.

methods.name: withRunnable
methods.description: Runs a given async callback within a timeout context for a specified runnable.

methods.name: _updateTimeout
methods.description: Updates the timeout timer based on the current slot and elapsed time.

methods.name: slow
methods.description: Increases the timeout for the current slot by a factor of three.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a new timeout value for the current slot.

methods.name: currentSlotDeadline
methods.description: Returns the deadline timestamp for the current slot.

methods.name: currentSlotType
methods.description: Returns the type of the current runnable.

methods.name: _createTimeoutError
methods.description: Creates and returns a detailed timeout error for the current runnable.
